Trace

Product · Brand · Web

Trace overlays screenshots on any app so designers and developers can compare an implementation pixel by pixel. Built for macOS.

Download

Design

Trace follows macOS 26's interface conventions. Native patterns and custom components keep the controls familiar while the overlay does its work.

Development

Built in Swift and SwiftUI, with AI-assisted development.
